# Synthetic robots.txt in the layout of docs.aws.amazon.com's: one group for
# every user agent, a sitemap, path rules none of which covers the guide, and a
# crawl delay. The delay differs from the recorded 5 seconds so a test can
# tell it was read.
User-agent: *
Sitemap: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sitemap_index.xml
Disallow: /AmazonExampleLegacy/2006-03-01/
Disallow: /forms/
Disallow: /search/
Disallow: /ask-docs/
Crawl-delay: 3
